# Vitamin D3 supplement ranking - best vitamin D3 supplements 2026  
**Vitamin D3** is one of the chemical compounds necessary for the proper functioning of our body. It is primarily responsible for bone formation, especially during the period of intensive growth. For this reason, the intake of this vitamin is also recommended for children. **Vitamin D** is produced when exposed to sunlight and is also found in food, especially fatty fish and dairy products. However, given the lack of sufficient sunshine throughout the year and the low amounts of vitamin **D** in food, vitamin **D** supplementation is extremely important. To supplement the diet with this valuable vitamin, adults should take 20-50 µg per day between October and March or throughout the year if sun exposure is insufficient, and children from 1 to 10 years of age 15-25 µg per day. In addition to its impact on bone health, **vitamin D3** also supports proper muscle function and immunity.
